name: video-ppp
description: 本地视频截图、优选与横转竖工具
author: qh775885

scripts.clean:artifacts: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "foreach ($p in @('dist','extracted_asar')) { if (Test-Path $p) { Remove-Item $p -Recurse -Force } }; $releaseRoot = 'release'; if (!(Test-Path $releaseRoot)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $releaseRoot | Out-Null }; foreach ($p in @(('视频截图神器-' + $env:npm_package_version + '-绿色版'), ('视频截图神器 Setup ' + $env:npm_package_version + '.exe'), ('视频截图神器 Setup ' + $env:npm_package_version + '.exe.blockmap'), 'builder-debug.yml', 'latest.yml')) { $full = Join-Path $releaseRoot $p; if (Test-Path $full) { Remove-Item $full -Recurse -Force } }"
scripts.build:dir: npm run clean:artifacts && npm run verify && electron-builder --win dir && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$base = 'release'; $src = Join-Path $base 'win-unpacked'; $dst = Join-Path $base ('视频截图神器-' + $env:npm_package_version + '-绿色版'); if (Test-Path $dst) { Remove-Item $dst -Recurse -Force }; if (Test-Path $src) { Move-Item $src $dst }; foreach ($p in @('.icon-ico','builder-debug.yml')) { $full = Join-Path $base $p; if (Test-Path $full) { Remove-Item $full -Recurse -Force } }"
scripts.build:setup: npm run clean:artifacts && npm run verify && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.build:release: npm run clean:artifacts && npm run verify && electron-builder --win nsis
